title: Mission Critical Security Engineer – Threat Hunting
description:
Help protect what truly matters in our customers' most critical environments by proactively identifying threats and improving how they are detected and addressed. 

As a Mission Critical Security Engineer with a focus on Threat Hunting, you will be part of a dedicated customer team responsible for securing and continuously improving a complex, mission-critical application landscape.

Working alongside other engineers and security specialists, you will help ensure the environment remains as secure and resilient as possible. You combine a strong engineering foundation with a security mindset, taking ownership of security improvements and understanding how systems, applications, and infrastructure behave.

Your specific focus will be on threat hunting and detection engineering. Using your in-depth knowledge of the customer's technology stack and application landscape, you will fine-tune existing detection use cases and develop new ones tailored to the environment. You will use our custom SIEM/SOAR-based Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform to turn emerging threats and technical insights into actionable detection capabilities.

This role bridges security engineering, detection engineering, and threat intelligence. You don't simply follow predefined playbooks. You understand system behavior, identify gaps, and develop practical solutions that strengthen the security of the customer's environment.

/ What you will do

Threat intelligence & continuous improvement 

- 
Actively follow security developments, vulnerabilities, and threat intelligence and translate these into relevant hunts and detections.

- 
Identify security risks and gaps in detection coverage and proactively propose improvements.

- 
Use your knowledge of the customer's application and infrastructure landscape to continuously strengthen its security posture.

- 
Contribute to the evolution of the team's security monitoring and detection strategy.

Communication & advisory 

- 
Translate findings into clear, actionable communication for engineers, customer stakeholders, and security specialists.

- 
Contribute to security advisories and share relevant threats across the customer team and wider organization.

- 
Work closely with engineers to understand system behavior and validate detection strategies.

- 
Collaborate with the customer's Security Operations Center (SOC) to align security monitoring, threat detection, and response activities.

- 
Help establish and improve integrations with the customer's SIEM/SOAR platform, including the forwarding of relevant logs and security telemetry.

Detection engineering & threat hunting 

- 
Develop and continuously improve detection use cases based on emerging threats and observed behavior.

- 
Translate threat scenarios and security insights into actionable detection logic tailored to the customer's environment.

- 
Proactively perform threat hunting across the application and infrastructure landscape to identify abnormal or suspicious patterns.

- 
Analyze logs and telemetry data to uncover behaviors that are not yet covered by existing detections.

- 
Use your understanding of the customer's technology stack to distinguish normal from potentially malicious behavior.

Use case development & response design 

- 
Define what should happen when detections trigger, including response actions, automation, and escalation paths.

- 
Continuously refine detection logic to improve quality, relevance, and signal-to-noise ratio.

- 
Build and fine-tune custom detection scenarios based on the specific characteristics and security requirements of the customer's environment.

Platform collaboration 

- 
Leverage our custom SIEM/SOAR-based MDR platform to implement detections and analyze data.

- 
Collaborate with platform and automation engineers to improve integrations and detection capabilities.

- 
Apply engineering and automation practices to ensure detection solutions are scalable, reliable, and maintainable.

/ What you bring

We are looking for someone who combines solid engineering fundamentals with a strong interest in security and is motivated to move towards or deepen their expertise in threat hunting and detection engineering.

You don't necessarily need to be an experienced threat hunter already. What matters is your ability to understand complex systems, recognize unusual behavior, and translate technical insights into practical security improvements.

Must-have skills 

- 
Solid engineering fundamentals, including Linux, networking, and infrastructure behavior.

- 
Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or similar platforms.

- 
Experience with CI/CD, Git, and configuration management or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

- 
Strong automation mindset and the ability to translate problems into scalable solutions.

- 
Experience working with logs and telemetry to analyze system behavior and investigate technical issues.

- 
Experience with Python and/or Bash scripting.

- 
Familiarity with SIEM or log analytics platforms such as OpenSearch, Elastic, Splunk, or Microsoft Sentinel.

- 
Strong understanding of security principles, including threat detection and response.

- 
Ability to distinguish normal from abnormal system behavior.

- 
Analytical, curious, and driven to understand how systems and threats behave.

- 
Ownership mindset, with responsibility for security quality and continuous improvement.

- 
Strong communication skills to translate technical findings into actionable insights.

- 
Ability to connect business and customer context to technical security solutions.

Nice-to-have skills 

- 
Hands-on experience with threat hunting, detection engineering, or advanced SOC operations.

- 
Experience developing or improving detection use cases and security monitoring rules.

- 
Experience with SOAR or security automation.

- 
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, and other Microsoft cloud services.

- 
Familiarity with threat intelligence frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

- 
Experience integrating SIEM/SOAR platforms or forwarding security telemetry between different environments.

/ Who are you?

You are an engineer with a strong interest in security, driven to understand how systems behave and how threats manifest.

You don't follow playbooks blindly. You want to understand why detections exist, how systems interact, and where security can be improved.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy working with complex applications, infrastructure, and data. You are curious, proactive, and take ownership of the quality of your work.

You also enjoy being part of a customer team where security is a shared responsibility. You work closely with fellow engineers and security specialists, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute to keeping the entire environment secure.

/ What can you expect?

At Schuberg Philis, you'll join a community of engineers with an awesome combination of exceptionally high security standards, an infatuation with automation, and the power to make a positive, sustainable impact on customers' business.

You'll work within a dedicated customer team where engineers and security specialists jointly take responsibility for the security and reliability of mission-critical environments.

Due to the nature of our customer engagements, there is no pressure on (billable) hours; we focus on quality and impact or how we like to call it: freedom & responsibility . You know best how to deliver the most value.

You'll be embedded in a company committed to helping colleagues grow as people and professionals through training, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and good old-fashioned fun.

Our offices are high-quality workspaces, and we go way beyond what is expected. We have productive equipment, good food and drinks, team outings, family days, labs to experiment with innovative technologies, etc.

We're active in relevant tech communities, attending and organizing meetups and conferences, and we organize internal knowledge-sharing events where Tech Leads play an important role.

If you're an engineer in the Netherlands with a strong interest in security and want to help secure mission-critical environments while developing or deepening your expertise in threat hunting and detection engineering, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

Your Impact 

- Lead the design, training, and deployment of reinforcement learning policies for robot motion — bridging the gap from simulation to reliable real-world performance

- Provide senior technical guidance on RL and learning-based control across the team, mentoring engineers and establishing best practices for policy development workflows

- Own and evolve the RL training infrastructure and sim-to-real pipeline, ensuring reproducibility, scalability, and fast iteration cycles

- Shape the technical vision for internal ML tooling and experiment management (e.g. training dashboards, automated evaluation pipelines), driving efficiency and rigour across the team's learning workflows

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify how to expand the robot's autonomous operational envelope

- Triage field issues related to locomotion, recognise failure patterns, and rapidly improve policy robustness based on real deployment data

- Write, deploy, and maintain efficient Python and C++ software for the learning and locomotion stack

Your Profile 

- PhD in robotics, machine learning, computer science or a related field with a strong focus on reinforcement learning; alternatively, an equivalent track record of RL research and deployment in robotics Or

- Master's degree from a top-tier technical university (e.g. ETH Zurich, EPFL) in robotics, machine learning, computer science or related field and 5+ years of professional experience

- Proven track record of shipping ML models to the field and maintaining those solutions over time

- Solid grounding in robot control fundamentals and autonomous systems, including: motion control, state estimation, path planning and actuation

- Experience using robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo or Isaac Sim

- Strong understanding of sim-to-real transfer, domain randomisation, reward shaping, and policy robustness techniques

- Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch); working knowledge of C++

- Strong knowledge of Linux systems and middleware frameworks for integrating learned components into a larger software stack

- Pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset — comfortable balancing research exploration with production delivery

- Excellent communication skills in English

Bonus Points 

- Experience training and deploying RL policies on physical robots — not just in simulation

- Development of scalable and modular robot architectures of motion control systems

- Experience with navigation systems and autonomous mobile robot operation in unstructured environments

- Interest in agentic engineering toolchains

- Experience leading software architecture design and software engineering best practices

- A solid grasp of physical systems, specifically multibody dynamics, electromechanical drive physics, energy optimization, and contact physics, to ensure learned policies respect hardware limits and transfer successfully from simulation to the real world

We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description:
Senior Stack Scientist 

About EH Energy Engineering 

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities 

- Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

- Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

- Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

- Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

- Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

- Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

- Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

- Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required 

- PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

- 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

- Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

- Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

- Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

- Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

- Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

- Management experience

- English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

- Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
- Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
- Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
- A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
- Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
- A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
- A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
- An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
- Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.
Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

- Youâre humbleââyou put the team and othersâ needs ahead of your own
- Youâre hungry to learn more
- Youâre people smartââin the sense that youâre a great teammate
The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that.

Youâll also enjoy the following benefits:

- Monthly team events and activities
- Weekly team lunches
- Casual dress code
- Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
- Remote working is okay with us too.
And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?

Job opportunities like this donât come along often, and weâve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Associate Data Scientist is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but itâs our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

- 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- 
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

We're looking for a RevOps Systems Architect to help build a modern, AI-powered revenue operations stack. This isn't a traditional Salesforce admin role. We're building a GTM tech stack where AI is a first-class citizen, automations are genuinely intelligent, and our CRM is a living system that reflects how our business actually works.

You'll function as a Salesforce admin and backend developer in one. You'll own platform administration, build complex automations via Flows and Apex, and develop and maintain custom services and integrations, including Salesforce MCP servers and AI tooling that connect our CRM to the broader systems our team runs on. For larger engineering efforts, you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with our engineering team, scoping and shipping together.

In this role, you will:

- 
Administer our Salesforce org: object model, data architecture, user configuration, and platform health.

- 
Build and maintain automations via Salesforce Flows, Apex, and custom services that power our GTM processes end to end.

- 
Develop and maintain Salesforce MCP servers and AI tooling that extend CRM functionality into AI-powered workflows.

- 
Design and maintain SQL-based data pipelines that feed dashboards and revenue reporting across the org.

- 
Translate ambiguous business problems into clean technical scope, from stakeholder conversation to implemented solution.

Requirements 

- 
Salesforce administration experience with deep familiarity across the object model, Flows, data loading tools, and platform configuration.

- 
Strong Apex development skills: you can build, debug, and maintain custom logic, triggers, and integrations without leaning on a separate engineering team.

- 
SQL proficiency: you can decompose ambiguous questions into answerable queries and are comfortable with complex joins, aggregations, and pipeline logic.

- 
Systems mindset: you can hold an end-to-end process in your head, trace a field from its origin through every downstream dependency, and anticipate what breaks when something changes.

- 
Excited by modern tooling: you're drawn to building AI-native systems and are curious about where Salesforce, MCP, and AI agents intersect.

Bonus:

Familiarity with dbt or modern data transformation tooling.

- 
Experience with BI tools such as Sigma or Looker.

Location

- Youâve made real tradeoffs between model cost and quality, and you can show the numbers that proved quality held.

- You use coding agents and AI review tools every day, and theyâve changed how fast you ship without lowering the quality of your work.

- Strong Python skills. Experience with Django and TypeScript is a plus.

Why Consider This Role? 

- Your work pays real claims to real pet parents. Youâll see the impact in production.

- Youâll have real scope on a small team, making decisions a larger company would spread across several people.

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ditto https://docs.ditto.live/home/about-ditto I've been obsessed with CRDTs since I first saw them at Strange Loop years ago, and I still can't quite believe I now get to work on them for a living — in some of the most challenging environments there are: disconnected, degraded, contested, out where the cloud isn't. If that's your kind of problem, come build with us. Ditto is the edge-native data platform that keeps distributed systems in sync when the network doesn't cooperate — an offline-first, CRDT-based layer syncing any device (phone, vehicle, sensor, server) over Bluetooth LE, P2P Wi-Fi, LAN, and tactical radio, with or without connectivity. Same core, commercial to defense; operationally deployed and network-agnostic. The problems are the fun kind: conflict-free replication with no server and no synchronized clock, multi-transport routing that never drops the connection, moving a coherent picture over links as thin as an HF radio shot, and human-in-the-loop robotics/autonomy where a detection may have to be physically carried by a moving node. Concept to field in days, not months. Most roles are open to anyone authorized to work in the U.S.; Public Sector and forward-deployed roles require U.S. person status. The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. - Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions

- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals

- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't

- A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases

- Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews

- A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly

- An insatiable desire and ability to learn

- BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required: 

- Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language

- Experience with TypeScript and Node.js

- Experience with Agile development

- Experience building and integrating with REST APIs

- Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)

- Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)

- Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams

- Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)

Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- 
Own production infrastructure: Build and maintain a growing ecosystem of internal safety services, taking ownership of their architecture, deployment, reliability, monitoring, and ongoing operation.

Bring ML models into production: Partner closely with ML engineers to deploy and integrate fine-tuned and proprietary ML models into production safety systems, ensuring they operate reliably and efficiently at scale.

-

-

- 
Proficiency in Python and experience with modern backend frameworks.

Experience building and maintaining distributed systems and cloud-based applications.

- 
Comfortable owning systems end to end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance.

- 
Experience working across different parts of the stack, with the ability to build internal tools or frontend interfaces when needed.

- 
Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to navigate ambiguous requirements and make pragmatic engineering decisions.

- 
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and non-technical stakeholders across different functions.

Bonus 

- 
Experience building Trust & Safety, content moderation, fraud detection, or abuse prevention systems.

- 
Experience building guardrails or safety infrastructure for AI agents and LLM-based applications.

- 
Experience deploying and integrating ML models into production applications.

- 
Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

- 
Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

- 
Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks.

- 
Experience with real-time data processing, event-driven architectures, or technologies such as Kafka and Redis.

Location

title: Senior Software Engineer, Product
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. 

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. 

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

The Role 

We’re looking for a Product oriented Fullstack Engineer to design, build, ship, and own end-to-end product features used by thousands of developers and hundreds of millions of end-users.

We’re specifically looking for someone with a strong backend foundation who is also genuinely proficient in React.

This is a hands-on IC role. We are looking for someone product-focused, but deeply technical. You’ll work across frontend, backend, and data boundaries, making thoughtful tradeoffs to deliver reliable, high-quality systems. You’ll take ownership from problem definition through production rollout and long-term maintenance, the scoping and prioritization work as much as the code.

“Product-focused” at RevenueCat means pairing strong engineering fundamentals with good judgment, customer obsession, and a bias toward shipping — not trading correctness, reliability, or scalability for speed, but also not letting “perfect” get in the way of “shipped today.”

About You 

- 
You have 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend foundation and a track record of building and operating high-scale production systems.

- 
You can write advanced SQL statements beyond basic SELECT and UPDATE statements.

- 
You’re proficient in React and have genuinely built on the frontend before. You’re comfortable owning UI work, not just backend APIs.

- 
You have solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals, and an understanding of HTTP and browser–server interactions

- 
You hold a high bar for quality and instinctively know which details matter, but also are discerning enough to cut scope when needed while still delivering value.

- 
You’re customer-obsessed: you imagine yourself as the developer, product manager, or marketer using the feature or experiencing the issue.

- 
You’re a builder, not an implementer: scoping, prioritizing, and driving rollout in partnership with our Product team. This isn’t a role where you check off items from a detailed specification.

- 
You can quickly familiarize yourself with code you didn't write yourself and improve it.

- 
You're comfortable coding alongside AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code. You use them to move faster on the parts that don't need your full attention, and you're detail-oriented enough to catch when they're wrong.

- 
You’re scrappy and biased toward shipping. You’d rather ship a good version today and iterate than wait to ship a perfect one next quarter.

- 
You communicate clearly, both in real-time and asynchronously. We’re a fully remote team, and how you write is as important as how you code.

- 
You’ve shipped meaningful user-facing features to production, monitored their usage and adoption, and improved them over time.

- 
You write high-quality, well-tested code, debug issues methodically, and help raise the engineering bar through thoughtful feedback and mentorship.

- 
You act like an founder:: you notice problems, propose improvements, and follow through fast.

Technologies you’ll likely work with: 

- 
TypeScript

- 
React

- 
PostgreSQL

- 
Python

- 
Flask

- 
AWS-hosted systems, following best practices for deployment, monitoring, and reliability

A note: Our interview process includes two separate live-coding sessions: one on frontend fundamentals and one on SQL, data logic, and algorithmic programming. We've found strength in both is a strong predictor of success in this role.

In the first month, you’ll: 

- 
Meet frequently with your team and manager to get up to speed.

- 
Get familiar with our tools, processes, and core subscription-business concepts.

- 
Complete a First Ship project.

- 
Jump in early: fix bugs, ship small improvements, and weigh in on PRs.

Within the first 3 months, you’ll: 

- 
Have shipped a medium-sized project successfully.

- 
Understand the main product areas your team owns and how they work end to end.

- 
Scope and work on projects self-sufficiently, from idea to post-launch improvements.

- 
Actively participate in code reviews, bug bashes, and technical discussions.

- 
Continuously improve areas of your team’s codebase and product.

Within the first 6 months, you’ll: 

- 
Become the go-to engineer for certain focus areas.

- 
Proactively contribute to architecture discussions that impact more than just your team.

- 
Debug issues across frontend, backend, and data; communicate clearly during incidents; drive fixes that prevent repeats.

- 
Engage directly with customers to understand how your work actually lands.

- 
Mentor other engineers joining the team and raise the bar through feedback and guidance.

Within the first 12 months, you’ll: 

- 
Know all the major components of our system and be able to debug complex issues across it.

- 
Spec and architect large projects, gather feedback, and drive design validation and rollout plans.

- 
Lead your own initiatives for improving our product and systems, grounded in real customer and business priorities.

What we offer: 

- 
Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

- 
10-year window to exercise vested equity options

- 
A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

- 
4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

- 
Paid desk at a co-working space

- 
Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat 

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat , including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

- 
The values that guide how we work: Our Values 

- 
How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat 

- 
What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations 

- 
What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

How private or secure is it to hold your driver's license or passport up to a webcam to get a bank account? Was it ever private or secure? Stable diffusion can break so much of this already. Our mission is to allow them to be controlled by individuals, with safeguards to prevent descents into surveillance states and checkpoint societies. Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.



About the role


We're looking for an engineer to drive the evolution of OrioleDB and its collaboration with the upstream PostgreSQL community. OrioleDB is a next-generation storage engine for PostgreSQL, and this role sits at the intersection of database internals, open source community work, and Supabase's managed Postgres platform.


This role requires strong working overlap with Americas time zones due to production support and on-call responsibilities.


What you'll work on 



- 
New OrioleDB features. Design and implement new capabilities in OrioleDB — for example, native index access methods (GiST, GIN, HNSW for pgvector), disaster recovery tooling, and other storage-engine-level features that expand what OrioleDB can do.




- 
Stability. Strengthen OrioleDB's reliability through deeper test coverage, fault injection, crash and recovery testing, and improvements to CI infrastructure. Ensure regressions are caught early and that OrioleDB behaves predictably under stress, replication, and failure scenarios.




- 
Upstream collaboration. Contribute changes directly to PostgreSQL core. Part of OrioleDB lives as a patch on top of PostgreSQL — moving the right pieces upstream shrinks what we maintain ourselves and benefits the wider community. This happens through PostgreSQL's open development process: the pgsql-hackers mailing list, public code review, and commitfests.




- 
Supabase integration. Work with Supabase's Postgres team to ensure OrioleDB fits naturally into Supabase's managed offering and roadmap.





You Will: 



- 
Design, implement, and test new OrioleDB features and integrate them cleanly with PostgreSQL's planner, executor, and surrounding subsystems.




- 
Build out and maintain test infrastructure: regression suites, fuzzing, randomized testing, crash and recovery testing, and CI pipelines.




- 
Identify and prepare patches suitable for upstreaming to PostgreSQL core.




- 
Improve performance, resilience, monitoring, and operational tooling for production use.




- 
Debug and resolve complex issues in low-level C code, including in storage, replication, indexing, and query execution paths.




- 
Participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews — both inside Supabase and in the PostgreSQL community.




- 
Write clear technical documentation, design notes, and upstream proposals.




- 
Contribute to troubleshooting, analyzing, supporting and maintaining OrioleDB in production deployments. This can include answering support ticket requests, an on-call rotation, and supporting our team members in troubleshooting and fixing live customer production databases.

- 
An existing PostgreSQL core contributor or have equivalent experience in Database internals.




- 
An expert C programmer with 8+ years of production experience with focus on low-level systems programming




- 
Deeply familiar with PostgreSQL’s codebase, build system, and extension APIs.




- 
Have experience designing or implementing database storage engines, index structures, or query execution components.

Comfortable contributing to community‑driven, upstream open source projects.

Proficient in debugging and profiling complex C code in a database context.

Able to write clear technical documentation and explain design trade‑offs.




- 
A strong communicator, committed to an open and collaborative development process.

Health Benefits

- 
Annual Off-Sites

Flexible Work

Professional Development

About the Team

title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
About hyperexponential (hx) 

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Engineering team 

At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology.

Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users.

About the role 

Underwriters at the world's largest insurers still do much of their work in spreadsheets, email threads, and systems that were never designed for the decisions they are making. We are rebuilding that from the ground up.

You will join the Workflow Underwriting stream, building the next generation of our underwriting platform. This is not a platform with AI features bolted on. We are designing it around the agents we build, which means the architecture, the domain model, and the interaction patterns are all genuinely open questions. You will help answer them.

You will contribute at code, architecture, and domain level from your first weeks, and you will talk directly to the underwriters who use what you build.

What you’ll be doing 

- Design, build, and operate backend services in Kotlin or Java, and own them in production.

- Turn ambiguous underwriting problems into simple, reliable software. Much of the work is deciding what to build, not just building it.

- Shape architectural decisions: APIs, domain models, persistence, reliability, observability, and how the platform evolves without collapsing under its own weight.

- Build real depth in the underwriting domain, to the point where you can challenge a requirement rather than only implement it.

- Design and build agent-assisted workflows, and make judgement calls about where an agent should act, where it should advise, and where a human must stay in control.

- Use AI coding tools, including Claude, as a core part of how you work. You delegate substantial work to them and you remain accountable for the quality, security, and correctness of everything you ship.

- Work across boundaries with frontend engineers, product partners, and client-facing teams, and step outside your specialism when the problem demands it.

- Give and take direct feedback, and raise the engineering bar around you.

- Strong professional experience building and running backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or another JVM language.

- Judgement in architecture and system design: a feel for what to build now, what to defer, and what will hurt in two years.

- Evidence of shipping software that solved a real customer or business problem, ideally something you owned end to end.

- A self-starting approach. You find the highest-value problem rather than waiting for a ticket.

- Clear communication. You can hold the same conversation with an underwriter, an executive, and an engineer, and adjust for each.

- Genuine appetite for problems with no known answer, and comfort working without a precedent to copy.

- Confident, responsible use of AI coding tools, with a critical eye on their output.

- Receptiveness to feedback. We give it directly and often, and we expect you to give it back.

Helpful, not required 

- Experience in insurance, underwriting, or another complex regulated domain. We will teach you the domain. We cannot teach curiosity about it.

- Experience across both backend and frontend.

- Experience building workflow, decision-support, or agent-assisted products.

- Experience working directly with enterprise clients.

- You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges.

- You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious.
